metadata.explanation: Record lost, without a notification, a background command whose recording or watch stop exhausted its retries; a watch left running ends by itself.
End a report whose start exhausted its retries; the Session Service logged each failed start.
End a handoff whose deployment request exhausted its retries; the next handoff or a manual Start deploys again.
Begin consuming accepted input.
Start the model turn of the answers to the pending user question.
Settle the request from the observed instance, apply an accepted lease and resume the waiting branches.
Wait durably for the requested timer or steering input.
Wait for the BackgroundCommandFlow SubFlow that follows a background command, or for the stop of its watch, then record how it ended and notify the Agent, unless it was stopped.
Join unique results from the expected tool batch.
Wait on remote reports, steering and notifications, then use the Session's ordinary tool path.
Wait for the Sandbox deadline of the READY request, then revoke the lease of the idle instance and have the SessionWorkspaceFlow reclaim it.
Wait, bounded, for the outcome the SessionWorkspaceFlow reports, or read it from that Flow once the wait ends.
Wait for approval matching the pending tool CallID.
Wait for queued input, steering, the answers to a pending question or a notification; a notification may open an automatic turn.
Call the segment's model with the replayed context segment and record the reply by its stop reason.
Apply the user's Stop, notifications and steering at a safe boundary before continuing.
Summarize the context segment and open the next one that starts with the summary.
Complete the Session of a deleting Project, which releases its resources by label.
Ask the Preview once to build and deploy each pushed commit, on the accepted workspace; reclamation races resume it.
Run one branch of an admitted parallel tool batch.
Run one tool with stable effect identity and bounded execution.
End the stopped turn: answer its unfinished calls interrupted_by_user, pause automatic turns and wait for the user.
Admit the Session, then initialize the Agent state, the entry log, an empty workspace and the creator's first message.
Stop the foreground command of the stopped turn and every running background command, holding no lock.
Keep the old segment after a failed compaction, or open an unsummarized one at the hard limit, and continue the turn.
Record the failed model call as a bounded turn failure and wait for the user.
Record a provider outcome only under the originally admitted executor and turn.
Record a serial tool call whose retries are exhausted as a platform failure the model reads, and report it beside the turn.
Settle a workspace request whose Step was rejected, exhausted its retries or passed its wait limit, record why, and resume the waiting branches.
Publish a classified failure for one parallel tool branch.
Beside the turn, which never waits for it, start without a lock the PlatformIssueFlow of a platform failure's signature, which files it; only a failed start is retried.
Record one stable Sandbox request, or join the request already in flight.
Route built-in, serial, or parallel tools under the approved policy.
Send the SessionWorkspaceFlow the command of the request, which provisions its instance after reclaiming an earlier one, or the reclaim command of a revoked request.
Settle a foreground bash command after its timeout or exhausted retries from the Sandbox's command ledger.
